results_excerpt.title: BD BodyComm™ version 3.3 software used for BodyGuard infusion pumps, BodyGuard-T and T34 syringe drivers: Important steps to manage transition to Windows 11 (DSI/2025/006)
Dialog+ haemodialysis machines with software versions 9.xx (excluding versions 9.18, 9.1A, 9.1B) – software and hardware upgrade required (MDA/2019/024)
results_excerpt.summary: Manufactured by B. Braun Avitum AG – Malfunction of the temperature sensor can result in temperature of the dialysis fluid to be more than ±1°C outside the programmed values, which can lead to inadequate treatment.
